description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'TerminationReasonConfigurationDao' for managing termination reasons in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to create, read, update, delete, and query termination reasons, with support for filtering, pagination, and existence checks.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDao
classes.description: Provides data access methods for termination reasons, including CRUD operations, searching, counting, and deletion within the system.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a TerminationReason entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingTerminationReasonIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of termination reasons that exist in the database matching provided IDs.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason entity by its name, trimmed of whitespace.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on provided search filter parameters, with pagination.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for termination reasons based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the number of termination reasons matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons identified by a list of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with the given name already exists, after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of termination reasons that are currently associated with employee termination records.
